ideas.pitch: A ground-station computer vision system using a monocular camera and OpenCV to calculate real-time wind drift and optimal drop coordinates for golf ball payloads.
ideas.title: AeroDrop Target Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at winning the scoring criteria for payload accuracy and drop efficiency without violating the prohibition on pre-programmed flight assistance.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, standalone telemetry module measuring G-force, altitude, and vibration to verify safety compliance and post-flight performance parameters.
ideas.title: FlightTelemetry Edge Logger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates strict adherence to safety and compliance rules while providing hard data for judges during design abstract evaluations.

ideas.pitch: A failsafe mechanical drop mechanism driven by a secure micro-servo and manual override switch to ensure reliable golf ball release during the 30-second flight window.
ideas.title: ServoRelease Mechanical Safety Gate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the mechanical reliability aspect of the payload drop, addressing a major failure point in aeromodelling competitions.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight aerodynamics calculation tool for rapid wing-loading and lift-to-drag estimation to optimize the 1.2m wingspan and 1kg weight constraints.
ideas.title: AeroSim CFD Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides rigorous engineering justification for the design abstract submission required for zonal selection.

ideas.pitch: A portable diagnostic test bench that verifies control surface deflection limits, motor draw currents, and CG balance before safety inspections.
ideas.title: AeroCheck Pre-Flight Diagnostic Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures the aircraft passes rigorous safety inspections on the first attempt, leveraging hard engineering utility.
